text:
Priya: Starting a cautious blue->green tilt for v2.10 in 2m. Window 22:00-23:30 PT. Steps: 3%, 6%, 15%, hold. Abort on p95>210ms or errors>0.4%.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: release/v2.10/canary -> pool-eu-1. Smoke tests queued.
Omar: Router pinned to 2.3.2 for this rollout (confirmed). Disabling header rewrite.
Priya: Ops to on-call: use router-admin to set weights and verify.
ReleaseBot: Weight update applied: green=3 -> green=6. Dash: https://grafana/team/releases/v2.10
Lynn: At 6% green p95=190ms, errors 0.1%. All good.
deploy-bot: Weight update applied: green=15.
Lynn: Alert: error-rate 0.55% at 15% green (threshold breached). Pausing rollout.
Priya: Paused. Do we rollback or debug in-place?
Omar: Traces point to auth-proxy timeouts on green only; likely a dependency mismatch.
Priya: Rollback to blue. Set green=0 and abort the canary.
deploy-bot: Rolling back: green=0 -> blue=100. Canary terminated.
ReleaseBot: Rollback complete. Incident created INC-8310. Please add RCA and note router pinning in the postmortem.
Lynn: Post-rollback p95 back to 135ms, errors 0.03%.
Priya: Good work. Devs to patch auth-proxy; will reattempt with extended staging validation and a narrower window. :thumbsup:
